{{Quote|Ne chutta ka wonga?''"<br />"''No, I don't need a hyperspace compass. Buzz off.|A lizard-like alien and Han Solo, speaking Huttese|<ref name="DE3" />}}
This '''compass''' was a circular [[Hyperspace compass/Legends|hyperspace compass]] that was owned by a [[Unidentified lizard-like alien (Nar Shaddaa)|lizard-like alien]] and located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]]. In [[10 ABY/Legends|10 ABY]] this lizard-like alien tried to sell the compass to [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]], speaking in [[Huttese/Legends|Huttese]] [[Language/Legends|language]], to which Han replied that he doesn't need hyperspace compass and told him to "buzz off".<ref name="DE3" />
